youtube.title: Eiffel Tower garmi mein lamba kyun ho jata hai? 🗼 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Eiffel Tower garmi mein sardi se zyada lamba hota hai. Wajah hai iron, jo garmi mein failta hai. Sabse garam dinon mein ye lagbhag pandrah centimetre tak badh jata hai.

Suraj jis taraf se zyada tapata hai, tower ka upar ka hissa uske ulti taraf thoda jhuk jata hai. Sardi mein ye wapas sikud jata hai, aur ye har saal hota hai.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
